what_it_contains: Every Norwegian barnehage: name, org.nr, owner type (privat/kommunal), address, number of children, staffing ratios, parent survey scores, contact, website
how_to_extract: Open API used by the site: https://www.barnehagefakta.no/api/ (e.g. /api/Barnehage/{orgnr}, /api/Location/kommune/{kommunenr}); also Udir's open data at https://data.udir.no; iterate kommune numbers and dump JSON to CSV, filter eierform=privat.

what_it_contains: Registry of all barnehager with org numbers, owner (eier) org number, status, addresses; enables grouping units by owner to identify chains
how_to_extract: REST API https://data-nbr.udir.no/v4/enheter (JSON), download all and group by 'ErInaktiv=false' and eier orgnr; join with Brønnøysund (data.brreg.no/enhetsregisteret/api) for owner names and roles (daglig leder).

what_it_contains: Company master data incl. naeringskode 88.911 (barnehager), daglig leder / styreleder roles, addresses, email/phone if registered
how_to_extract: GET /enheter?naeringskode=88.911&size=1000 (paginate); GET /enheter/{orgnr}/roller for daglig leder names.

what_it_contains: 1,695 member private barnehager with contact details
how_to_extract: Site search by kommune; scrape listing pages or request member list via PBL for partnership.

what_it_contains: Aggregated directory and statistics of Norwegian barnehager by kommune, incl. private chains
how_to_extract: Browse per kommune/bydel pages; scrape HTML listings.

what_it_contains: All förskolor with huvudman (operator) name and org.nr, address, municipality, status
how_to_extract: API: https://api.skolverket.se/skolenhetsregistret/v1/skolenhet (JSON); filter Skolform=Förskola; group by Huvudman org.nr to find chains; join with Bolagsverket/allabolag for VD names.

what_it_contains: Per operator (huvudman) and per group (koncern) listings of förskolor, e.g. Atvexa 161 units, Pysslingen 86
VD, board, employees, revenue per AB (used to confirm Dibber Sverige VD, Norlandia Förskolor board)
how_to_extract: Search by org.nr obtained from Skolverket huvudman field.

what_it_contains: All Danish daginstitutioner with institutionsnummer, type (kommunal/selvejende/privat), address, leader contact
how_to_extract: Download via https://institutionsregister.stil.dk (CSV/XML export, filter institutionstype = dagtilbud, ejerforhold = privat/selvejende).

what_it_contains: Counts of children per institution type and municipality
Legal entities with branchekode 88.91.10 (dagplejer/daginstitutioner), directors (direktion), addresses
how_to_extract: CVR search by branchekode; Elasticsearch API for bulk via Virk.

source_name: Varda (Opetushallitus early childhood registry) - open data
what_it_contains: All Finnish päiväkodit (public and private) with organiser (toimija), unit type, municipality, child counts
how_to_extract: Public API: https://backend.varda.opintopolku.fi/api/julkinen/v1/ (JSON, paginated); group by 'vakajarjestaja' to find private chains.

what_it_contains: Early-childhood education statistics by provider type and municipality
Company data incl. toimiala 88911 (lasten päiväkodit) and board/CEO
how_to_extract: Open API https://avoindata.prh.fi/ytj.html filter by business line code.

what_it_contains: Number of leikskólar, children and staff by municipality and ownership (public/private)

source_name: Menntamálastofnun / Miðstöð menntunar og skólaþjónustu school list
what_it_contains: Directory of leikskólar with contact and operator
how_to_extract: Download list; complement with Reykjavík city leikskóli directory https://reykjavik.is/leikskolar.
